title: Theoretical properties of the eigenvector method
summary: A classical proposal to derive weights from a pairwise comparison matrix is the right eigenvector. The literature has identified some potential weaknesses of this method in previous decades. This chapter discusses five of these issues. First, right-left asymmetry emerges because of the difference between the right and inverse left eigenvectors. Second, group incoherence for choice means that, in group decision-making problems, the ranking given by the aggregated individual weight vectors is not guaranteed to coincide with the ranking derived from the aggregated pairwise comparison matrix.…
